tasks.title: Professional UX review: smoothness, fewest clicks, practical pro UI + fix tasks
tasks.brief: Professional UX review (read-only audit, then follow-up fix tasks). Goal from owner Ahmed: find every flaw and deliver the BEST user experience for a pharmacist using the app all day: smooth, fewest clicks, practical, professional interface. Serve the CURRENT repo frontend locally (it already includes UX1-UX6 fixes; e.g. `npx http-server` on the frontend dir, or use worker/live/nova-rx-preview.ux-fixes1.js via `npx wrangler dev --local` if simpler) — do NOT hit the live server for writes. Write tools/qa/ux-pro-audit.mjs (Playwright headless Chromium; `npm ci && npx playwright install --with-deps chromium`), desktop 1366x768 and mobile 390x844. Walk real end-to-end pharmacist journeys with fake data: quick sale (search by name/barcode, add qty, discount, pay cash/card, print/sticker), return, purchase/receiving, stock lookup + low-stock, customer debt payment, prescription/chronic patient, daily report, settings. For each journey record: number of clicks/taps and keystrokes, time-to-complete, screen transitions, any dead ends, confusing labels, missing keyboard shortcuts (Enter/F-keys/barcode focus), missing confirmations or too many confirmations, slow interactions (measure INP/long tasks, first load, screen switch time), layout jank (CLS), inconsistent spacing/colours/buttons/typography, RTL issues, empty/error/loading states, accessibility (contrast, focus, tap target >=44px). Compare against best-practice POS UX and propose the ideal flow per journey with a target click count. Write .nova/qa/ux-pro-report.md in Arabic: executive summary, per-journey table (الرحلة | الكليكات الحالية | المستهدف | المشاكل | الحل), prioritized findings (عالية/متوسطة/منخفضة) with screenshots in .nova/qa/ux-pro/ (max ~40 small PNGs), performance numbers. Then write .nova/inbox/ux-pro.json = {"tasks":[...]} with one fix task per high/medium finding (group related, max 20), ids starting at UX9 (UX9, UX10, …), each {id, phase:10, title, brief, acceptance, after:[]} — frontend only, small, exact files + test to add (tests/unit or tests/ux, include click-count assertions for improved journeys), preserve Black Edition Arabic RTL, backend frozen, no deploys; set `after` only where a task truly builds on another. LAST item: a task (next UX id) that rebuilds the live Worker artifact worker/live/nova-rx-preview.ux-pro1.js from the repo frontend like UX7 did, after = all other new UX ids, must NOT deploy. Do not edit .nova/cloud-queue.json. Commit script, screenshots, report, inbox file on this branch.
tasks.acceptance: Arabic report .nova/qa/ux-pro-report.md with per-journey click counts (current vs target), perf numbers and prioritized findings with screenshots; valid .nova/inbox/ux-pro.json with UX9+ fix tasks and a final no-deploy artifact rebuild task; no live writes, fake data only.
